why: Analysis 1 commits to a narrow front-drive, shared-platform hedgehog with a per-vehicle/per-platform profit denominator and break-even guardrail, and it flags the celebrity-savior CEO, succession gap and undisciplined-acquisition risks that the key identifies. Analysis 2 is more cautious and slightly better calibrated, but by stopping at Gate 1 it offers no hedgehog and a thinner treatment of the leader-dependence and succession risks.
